about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Marie Rose Prawn Cocktail Sauce
recipes.summary: The pink, tangy sauce for a Christmas prawn cocktail, thick enough to coat cold prawns.
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and hot sauce until smooth.
Stir in the cream until the sauce is light and pink, then season with salt and pepper.
Taste and add more lemon if it needs sharpness.
notes: Serve over cold cooked prawns on shredded lettuce.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

recipes.title: Summer Christmas Potato Salad with Dill and Egg
recipes.summary: A creamy herby potato salad with soft chopped eggs for the Boxing Day cold table.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender when pierced, then drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until hard-set, cool in cold water, peel and chop.
Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar, dill, spring onions, capers, salt and pepper, then fold through the potato and eggs gently.
notes: Food safety: keep the salad chilled and do not leave it out for more than 2 hours, or 1 hour in hot weather.
Make it a day ahead for the best flavour.

recipes.title: Maple Mustard Roasted Broccoli Trees with Crunchy Pecan Crumble
recipes.summary: Roasted broccoli glazed with maple and mustard, finished with a crunchy pecan topping.
steps: Toss the broccoli with the oil, salt and pepper and spread on a baking tray.
Roast at 220°C for 18 minutes until browned at the edges and tender.
Stir through the maple, mustard and pecans and roast for 5 minutes more until glossy, then serve hot.
notes: Do not crowd the tray or the broccoli will steam.
Best served straight from the oven.

recipes.title: Honey Thyme Glazed Carrots and Sweet Potato Wedges for the Festive Table
recipes.summary: Roasted root vegetables with a sticky honey and thyme glaze for the Christmas roast.
steps: Toss the carrots and sweet potato with the oil and salt on a large tray.
Roast at 200°C for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden at the edges.
Drizzle with the honey and thyme and roast for 8 minutes more until sticky, then finish with the lemon juice.
notes: Cut the vegetables to similar thickness so they cook evenly.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Traditional English Bread Sauce
recipes.summary: Creamy, nutmeg-scented bread sauce that goes with roast poultry at Christmas.
steps: Heat the milk with the onion, bay leaves and nutmeg in a saucepan until barely simmering, then turn off the heat and infuse for 15 minutes.
Remove the onion and bay leaves and stir in the breadcrumbs.
Cook over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick, then add the butter, cream, salt and pepper.
notes: Loosen with a splash of milk if it thickens as it stands.
Keeps for 3 days; reheat gently with extra milk.

recipes.title: Apple and Orange Christmas Relish
recipes.summary: A chunky spiced apple and orange relish, a fruity alternative to cranberry sauce.
steps: Put the apples, orange zest and juice, sugar, vinegar and spices in a saucepan.
Simmer gently over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring, until the apple is soft and the liquid is thick and syrupy.
Cool and spoon into a jar.
notes: Serve warm or cold with ham and turkey.
Keeps in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Slow Caramelised Red Onion Pan Gravy for Sunday Roasts
recipes.summary: A deep onion gravy built from slowly browned red onions, flour and stock.
steps: Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over medium-low heat and cook the onions with the sugar for 25 minutes, stirring often, until deeply golden.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the stock gradually, stirring.
Add the vinegar, thyme and soy sauce and simmer for 10 minutes until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.
notes: Add pan juices from the roast for extra flavour.
Reheats well; add water if too thick.

recipes.title: Chinese Stir-Fried Lettuce with Garlic
recipes.summary: A quick, crunchy lettuce stir-fry with garlic and oyster sauce, popular at Lunar New Year.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over very high heat and add the garlic for 15 seconds until fragrant.
Add the lettuce and toss for 1 minute until just wilted but still crisp.
Stir in the oyster sauce, soy sauce and sugar, toss for a few seconds and finish with the sesame oil.
notes: Work fast because lettuce wilts quickly.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Lunar New Year Buddhist Vegetable Jai
recipes.summary: A braised vegetarian feast of mushrooms, tofu, cabbage and carrot in a savoury soy sauce.
steps: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes until soft, then slice, keeping 200ml of the soaking water.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden, then add the garlic, ginger, cabbage and carrots and stir-fry for 4 minutes.

Add the mushrooms, soaking water, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar, simmer for 8 minutes until the vegetables are tender, then stir in the cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water and the snow peas and cook until thickened.
Finish with the sesame oil.
notes: Soaking is not part of the prep time.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Cucumber Pickle for Banquets
recipes.summary: A crisp, bright pickle that cuts through rich banquet dishes.

items: 3 Lebanese cucumbers, chopped into bite-sized pieces

steps: Toss the cucumbers with the salt and leave for 10 minutes, then drain.
Stir the vinegar and sugar until dissolved and pour over the cucumbers.
Add the garlic, chilli and sesame oil and toss until evenly coated.
notes: Best the same day while still crisp.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Hot Sizzled Ginger Spring Onion Oil for Steamed Chicken and Fish
recipes.summary: A fragrant, salty ginger and spring onion oil poured hot over steamed chicken or fish.
steps: Mix the spring onions, ginger and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil in a small saucepan for 2 minutes until shimmering and just starting to smoke.
Pour the hot oil over the spring onion mixture so it sizzles, then stir in the soy sauce.
notes: Pour carefully, the oil is very hot.
Use within 2 days.

recipes.title: Kachumber Fine-Chopped Cucumber Tomato Red Onion Salad with Roasted Cumin
recipes.summary: A crisp, juicy Indian salad with lemon and roasted cumin, served alongside curries.
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomato, onion and chilli in a bowl.
Season with the lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Toss in the coriander and leave for 3 minutes until the juices mingle, then serve.
notes: Add the salt last so the salad does not turn watery.
Serve within 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Street Style Sweet Potato Chaat with Mint Yoghurt and Lime
recipes.summary: Roasted sweet potato cubes with spiced yoghurt, lime and crisp onions, a Diwali party snack.
steps: Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, garam masala and half the salt and roast at 210°C for 25 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Whisk the yoghurt with the mint, lime juice, sugar and remaining salt.
Pile the hot potatoes onto a plate and top with the yoghurt, onion and coriander.
notes: Serve straight away so the potato stays crisp.
Add a pinch of chilli powder for extra heat.

recipes.title: Dry Gobi Masala Cauliflower
recipes.summary: Spiced dry-fried cauliflower with ginger, tomato and cumin, ideal for Diwali spreads.

items: 1 small cauliflower, cut into small florets

steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat, add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds until sizzling, then cook the onion for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir in the ginger, garlic and spices, then add the tomato and cook for 3 minutes until pulpy.
Add the cauliflower and salt, cover and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender with golden spots, then top with the coriander.
notes: Add a splash of water if it starts to catch.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Thanksgiving Sage Apple and Celery Bread Dressing Baked Crisp on Top
recipes.summary: A buttery oven-baked bread dressing with sage, apple and celery, crisp on top and soft inside.
steps: Dry the bread cubes in a 160°C oven for 10 minutes until firm.
Melt the butter in a frying pan and cook the onion, celery and apple for 8 minutes until soft, then stir in the sage.
Mix everything with the stock, egg, salt and pepper, tip into a baking dish and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes until golden and the egg is set.
notes: Food safety: cook the dressing until it reaches at least 74°C in the centre, especially if it was stuffed in poultry.
Use stale bread for best texture.

recipes.title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipes.summary: Silky mashed potatoes with sweet roasted garlic and plenty of butter.
steps: Cut the top off the garlic head, drizzle with the oil, wrap in foil and roast at 200°C for 40 minutes until soft and golden.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 18 minutes until completely tender, then drain and steam dry.
Squeeze the garlic into the potatoes, add the butter and milk and mash until smooth.
notes: Warm the milk so the potatoes stay hot.
Reheat with a splash of milk.

recipes.title: Homemade Mushroom Cream Green Bean Bake with Crispy Fried Onion Crown
recipes.summary: Green beans in a creamy mushroom sauce topped with crisp golden onions, made without tinned soup.
steps: Boil the beans for 3 minutes until bright green, then drain.

Cook the mushrooms in the butter over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until browned, stir in the garlic and flour for 1 minute, then add the milk, cream, salt and pepper and simmer for 3 minutes until thick.
Fold in the beans, tip into a dish, top with the onion tossed in the oil and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until bubbling and the onions are crisp.
notes: Cover the dish loosely if the onions brown too fast.
Reheats well.

recipes.title: Orange Maple Sweet Potato Wedges Roasted with Cinnamon for Thanksgiving
recipes.summary: Sweet potato wedges roasted with orange, cinnamon and maple until caramelised.
steps: Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, cinnamon and salt on a large tray.
Roast at 210°C for 30 minutes until tender and browned at the edges.
Pour over the maple and orange juice and roast for 8 minutes more until sticky, then scatter with pecans and orange zest.
notes: Turn the wedges once for even browning.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Passover Apple and Walnut Charoset
recipes.summary: A sweet apple and walnut paste with cinnamon, symbolic on the Passover table.
steps: Mix the apples with the lemon juice to stop them browning.
Stir in the walnuts, honey and cinnamon.
Add the orange juice gradually until the mixture holds together like a chunky paste.
notes: Serve with matzo crackers.
Best eaten the day it is made.

recipes.title: Beetroot Salad with Horseradish Dressing
recipes.summary: Roasted beetroot with a creamy horseradish and lemon dressing.
steps: Wrap the beetroot in foil with the oil and roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until a knife slides in easily.
Cool, peel and cut into wedges.
Mix the sour cream, horseradish, lemon juice, dill and salt, then spoon over the beetroot.
notes: Wear gloves when peeling to avoid pink fingers.
Keeps for 3 days.

recipes.title: Passover Potato Kugel
recipes.summary: A crisp-edged baked potato pudding with onion and egg, a Passover and Shabbat favourite.
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Mix with the eggs, 2 tbsp oil, potato starch, salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a baking dish in a 200°C oven for 5 minutes, add the potato mixture and bake for 50 minutes until deep golden and crisp at the edges.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg is fully set in the centre and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Serve straight from the oven.

recipes.title: Carrot Tzimmes
recipes.summary: A sweet, slow-baked carrot dish with orange and cinnamon.
steps: Toss the carrots with the oil, honey, cinnamon, ginger and salt in a baking dish.
Add the orange juice, zest and water and cover tightly with foil.
Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 minutes more until tender and glazed.
notes: Serve with roast chicken or brisket.
Keeps for 3 days.

recipes.title: Pea and Potato Salad with Mint for Easter
recipes.summary: A fresh, minty potato salad with sweet green peas, perfect with Easter lamb.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 minutes until tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain and cool slightly.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt together.
Toss the warm potatoes and peas with the dressing, mint and spring onions.
notes: Dress while warm to soak in the flavour.
Serve warm or cold.
